description.en: Computes the Y-axis rotation (in degrees) a character would need to face a given world position.
Handle of the character to compute the rotation for.
Target world position [x, y, z] to face.
The Y-axis rotation, in degrees, needed to face _pos.

example.code:
// Turn a character to face a specific world position
CMND_CHR_TURN_TRG(_hdl, 0, GetRyLookAtPos(_hdl, [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]), 0);
